node: Dry-type transformers, distribution transformers, magnetics, power quality, switchgear-adjacent equipment, and low/medium-voltage power distribution
summary: Expanded the U.S.-listed/OTC universe for the transformer, power-quality, switchgear-adjacent and low/medium-voltage distribution node. The best underfollowed candidates are not the mega-cap electrical-equipment leaders, but smaller companies with custom-engineered electrical products, North American manufacturing footprints, data-center or utility exposure, and backlog sensitivity. Hammond Power Solutions is the cleanest transformer/power-quality exposure via U.S. OTC; Powell Industries is a higher-attention but still specialized custom power-distribution equipment company; Preformed Line Products is a second-order grid-hardware supplier tied to transmission buildout rather than transformers; IES Holdings is a data-center electrical infrastructure and custom-engineered solutions provider that may capture installation/integration demand rather than transformer manufacturing economics.
